crossings.note: Al Kharid / Lumbridge river boundary. Its two Gate locs are decorative -- opening them does nothing. walkTo across x=3268 is client_rejected from every tile tried until the toll dialog below is completed, at which point the same walk succeeds instantly. Confirmed live 2026-09-08.

open_problems.note: Dense cabbage/daisy/fern/plant garden reached heading north from the Al Kharid area. A 30-tile scanNearbyLocs came back with no Gate/Door/Stile/Fence anywhere in it. Locs north of roughly z=3310 report reachable:false while everything south reports reachable:true, which suggests the real blocker (a hedge, wall, or water edge) isn't exposed as an interactable loc at all here. Sidestepping east/west did move the character but never closed the gap north, since the blocking boundary appears to run the width of the area at a roughly constant z rather than being a single-point crossing. Logged 2026-09-08 rather than re-probed blind -- the working hypothesis is this approach (cutting north-west through Draynor's farm) isn't a real route at all, and the Lumbridge-Varrock road further east is the one to use instead.
